explanation: Its founder Frank McNamara is said to have dreamed it up after forgetting his wallet at a dinner. The first cards were made of cardboard and accepted at a few dozen New York restaurants.

claims.text: The Diners Club card, launched in New York in 1950, was first used to pay at restaurants.
The Diners Club card was not first meant for petrol stations, hotels or department stores.
Frank McNamara is said to have conceived the card after forgetting his wallet when dining out.
The first Diners Club cards were made of cardboard and accepted at a few dozen New York restaurants.
